en.headline: 399 own commits across 13 repos, with skill tooling and sandbox docs leading
en.teaser: Most work went into the sogeisetsu profile repo, an OpenCode agent sandbox, skill management tooling and a translation extension. Issue activity centered on OpenChamber and OpenCode bug reports.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-15 to 2026-11-13 with data for every day. Totals were 399 own commits plus 713 automated commits, 0 pull requests, 31 issue actions and 0 reviews.

### Profile repo and activity tooling

Most commits landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, which also carried all 713 automated commits. Work there added a 30-day GitHub activity AI summary with a home-page card and a standalone page, refactored the daily collection scripts into a shared `lib/days.mjs` helper, and fixed commit attribution for aliased and non-GitHub emails. Further fixes tightened the comment-count rules, corrected a +08 early-morning reply collection gap, stopped filtering candidate entries by updated_at, and added a `--force` flag to skip the frozen comment snapshot.

### OpenCode sandbox and skill tooling

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` was mostly a knowledge base: an initial commit, an AGENTS.md, and archived findings on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication, Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim, remote branch deletion risks, and corrections to stale conclusions. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`, normalized line endings to LF, and shipped four releases from 0.1.0-rc.0 through 1.2.0, including a JSON output schema and fixes to divergence counting and frontmatter boolean parsing.

### Translation extension and pixel tooling

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` started from an empty repo and grew an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, plus JSDoc type checking and DOM smoke tests; selection translation was later dropped. `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` added automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README with a Chinese version, a 40-image command gallery, and a Korean font fix, releasing v0.2.0 and v0.3.0.

### Model picker, reports and small repos

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v1.4.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1, covering shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery output, priced accounting with quota math, a large documentation reduction, and an enforced candidate menu. `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414, a single-button theme switcher, visual refinements, a GitHub repo button and a LICENSE. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` added two screenshot posts, `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` cut v1.15.5, and `sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` added a first commit porting OpenChamber features.

### Issue activity in other projects

Outside the user's own repos, issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber` and `anomalyco/opencode`, mostly bug reports on MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, dev-server discovery, context panel breakdown, Windows CLI access and MiMo image handling. One issue was opened against `microsoft/PowerToys` about a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException.

highlights.text: Opened and closed a temporary smoke-test issue for the opencode /oc flow.
Published v1.0.0, freezing the skill_management action surface for 1.x.
Published 3.0.0, cutting the model-facing documentation from about 104k to 8.3k characters.
Published v0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping and overflow protection.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects images.
Opened a Shortcut Guide bug about a NullReferenceException on Hold-Win activation.

zh.headline: 13 个仓库共 399 次本人提交，技能工具与沙箱文档为主
zh.teaser: 主要工作集中在个人主页仓库、OpenCode 智能体沙箱、技能管理工具和翻译扩展。issue 互动主要围绕 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 的缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-15 至 2026-11-13，每天都有数据。总计 399 次本人提交，另有 713 次自动提交，0 个 PR，31 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），0 次评审。

### 主页仓库与活动工具

提交最多的是 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，713 次自动提交也全部集中在这里。该仓库新增了近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结，包含首页卡片和独立页面；把每日采集脚本重构出共享的 `lib/days.mjs`；修复了别名邮箱和非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交归属。此外还收紧了评论数口径，修复了 +08 凌晨漏采回复的问题，取消了按 updated_at 过滤候选条目，并新增 `--force` 参数以跳过评论数快照冻结。

### OpenCode 沙箱与技能工具

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 主要作为知识库：初始提交、AGENTS.md，以及关于 OpenCode V2 分发、架构、认证、Windows 路径坑、oh-my-opencode-slim、远程分支删除风险等实测记录，并修正了若干过期结论。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，把计划迁到 `.openchamber/plans`，统一换行符为 LF，并从 0.1.0-rc.0 一路发布到 1.2.0，期间加入 JSON 输出 schema，修复了分歧计数和 frontmatter 布尔值解析问题。

### 翻译扩展与像素工具

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从空仓库起步，搭出 MV3 骨架、带预设与模型列表的 provider 协议层和术语表流水线，实现双语页面渲染、分块、熔断与进度显示，并加入 JSDoc 类型检查和 DOM 冒烟测试，后来移除了划词翻译。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 加入自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、英文优先并附中文版的 README、40 张命令示例画廊和韩语字体修正，发布了 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0。

### 模型选择器、报告与小仓库

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 v1.4.0、2.0.0、3.0.0 和 3.0.1，内容包括共享 JSON 与代理助手、更完整的智能体发现输出、带计价的配额计算、大幅精简文档以及强制候选菜单。`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复了 375 和 414 视口的移动端布局，把主题切换改为单按钮菜单，做了视觉精修，并加入 GitHub 仓库按钮和 LICENSE。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 新增两篇截图文章，`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 发布 v1.15.5，`sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` 提交了移植 OpenChamber 功能的首次提交。

### 其他项目的 issue 互动

在本人仓库之外，issue 互动集中在 `openchamber/openchamber` 和 `anomalyco/opencode`，多为缺陷报告，涉及 MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、开发服务器自动发现、上下文面板拆分、Windows 命令行入口和 MiMo 图片处理。另向 `microsoft/PowerToys` 提交了一个关于快捷指南空引用异常的 issue。

highlights.text: 新开并关闭了一个用于 opencode /oc 流程的临时冒烟测试 issue。
发布 v1.0.0，将 skill_management 的动作接口在 1.x 内冻结。
发布 3.0.0，把模型需阅读的文档从约 10.4 万字符压到 8.3 千字符。
发布 v0.3.0，加入自动折行与溢出保护。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 宣称支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
提交快捷指南在 Hold-Win 激活时抛出空引用异常的缺陷。
